definitions.gloss: visiting a hospital regularly; outpatient treatment
definitions.explanation: Regularly visiting a hospital or clinic for medical treatment without being admitted as an inpatient.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{二回|にかい}→二回：27625_nikai⟧{通院|つういん}している。
examples.english: I visit the hospital twice a week.

examples.japanese: {通院|つういん}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けている→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。
{通院|つういん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧な⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: Commuting to the hospital was difficult, so I changed to one nearby.

notes:
RELATED TERMS:
- {通院|つういん}⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧ (通院患者): outpatient
- {通院|つういん}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ (通院治療): outpatient treatment
- ⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧: hospitalization (inpatient)
- ⟦{外来|がいらい}→外来：09895_gairai⟧: outpatient department

INSURANCE:
{通院|つういん} is important in medical insurance contexts:
- ⟦{通院給付金|つういんきゅうふきん}→通院給付金：noentry⟧: outpatient benefit
- ⟦{通院保障|つういんほしょう}→通院保障：noentry⟧: outpatient coverage

CONTRAST:
- {通院|つういん}: Going to hospital without staying
- ⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧: Being admitted to hospital
